cause.client_newer_than_hub: this client is newer than the hub
cause.hub_refused: the hub no longer knows this client
cause.hub_untrusted: the hub's identity changed (it was reset or reinstalled)
code.bundle_missing: this install carries no {binary}; reinstall the client
code.client_disabled: the hub has switched this client off
code.client_internal: the client hit an unexpected error ({error}); check its log
code.client_newer_than_hub: this client ({client_version}) is newer than the hub ({hub_version}); update the hub first
code.control_channel_closed: the client stopped answering; open it again
code.control_peer_refused: the running client belongs to another account
code.control_socket_unavailable: this session has no place for the client's socket
code.crashed: the last request failed on this machine
code.credentials_missing: the saved login is gone; enter it again with Config
code.enroll_no_token: the hub sent no token back
code.enroll_refused: the hub refused this link; it may have expired, so generate a fresh one
code.fs_refused: this account may not use that folder
code.gui_webkitgtk_missing: the window needs WebKitGTK; install it: sudo apt install {packages}
code.gui_webview2_missing: the window needs {runtime}; install it and try again
code.hub_refused: the hub refused this client's token
code.hub_reply_unreadable: the hub sent a reply this client could not read
code.hub_untrusted: what answers is not the hub this link pins
code.link_incomplete: that link carries no hub address and token
code.link_missing: paste the link from the hub's Clients page
code.link_not_for_client: that link is for a device agent, not for a client
code.link_unreadable: that is not an enrollment link; copy the whole line from the hub
code.mount_not_authorized: mounting was not authorized on this machine
code.mount_tooling_missing: the mount tooling is missing on this machine
code.mountpoint_invalid: give a folder under your home, like ~/nas/share
code.mountpoint_not_drive_letter: give an unused drive letter, like N:
code.no_endpoint: the hub has not granted you a key yet
code.rdp_launch_failed: the RustDesk viewer could not be started: {detail}
code.rdp_no_address: that machine published no address to connect to
code.rdp_no_desktop: this session has no screen to open a viewer on
code.rdp_not_shared: that desktop is not shared any more
code.root_refused: the client runs as a person, never as root
code.self_unbound: {cause}; rejoin by pasting a fresh link from the hub
code.unknown_request: the client does not know this request
ui.ai_off: the tools are as they were
ui.ai_on: the tools point at the hub
ui.description.gitea_module: published by the Gitea module on {host}
ui.description.samba_module: published by the Samba module on {host}
ui.empty_desktops: no remote desktop is shared right now
ui.mount_drive_caption: Appears as this drive in File Explorer
ui.paste_hint: Paste the link from the hub's Clients page
ui.services_wait_join: Services appear once you join a hub.
